answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the knoll of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on verifiable delay functions interleaved with localized peer attestation quorums. Written in a long technical clauses, one short sentence to close register, it stays short. The walnut holds work receipts rather than names, so the raven of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
